title: A rectifiable representation lives on the support up to a null set (parent P2)
statement: For all P, n, every U ⊆ ℝ^P, every T ∈ D_n(U) and every (M, θ, ξ) with IsRectifiableTriple U n M θ ξ and T(ω) = τ(M,θ,ξ)(ω) for all ω ∈ Dⁿ(U): Hⁿ(M ∖ spt T) = 0 (Hⁿ = μHE[n]).
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Eucl P)) (T : GeometricCurrentOn U n) (M : Set (Eucl P)) (θ : Eucl P → ℝ) (ξ : Eucl P → NVector (Eucl P) n), IsRectifiableTriple U n M θ ξ → (∀ ω : TestFormOn U n, T ω = tauAction n M θ ξ ω) → (μHE[n] : Measure (Eucl P)) (M \ T.support) = 0
